m1 - SITE 3 SETTLED, and it is a CONFIRMED LIVE INSTANCE with the full chain answered per your new rule 4.

window.scala:122, WeightedMean. `if tw <= 0.0 then undefined(ZeroTotalWeight) else Estimate.observed(sum / tw)`.

PERMITS: yes, fail-open polarity.

OCCURS: YES, and this is the part reading would have got wrong. Sample is a public case class carrying a bare Double weight, and Reduction.reduce DOES gate it - samples.exists(!_.hasValidWeight) returns Left at :341, and the docstring at :8 says "Weights are checked by Reduction.reduce", which is TRUE. But WindowReducer is a PUBLIC TRAIT with a PUBLIC `def reduce`, and WindowReducer.scalar(...) is public. So there is a SECOND DOOR that does not run the gate.

PRODUCES: proven by execution, both doors run side by side on identical input:

  via Reduction.reduce            -> REFUSED: "negative or non-finite sample weight"
  via WindowReducer.reduce direct -> Observed(NaN, None)

That is exactly the value your rule 7 names - a measurement asserted, and something no arithmetic can use handed to the consumer.

CONSUMES: NOTHING IN MAIN, as far as I can find. The only WindowReducer.reduce call in main sources is window.scala:356, inside Reduction.reduce - the guarded path. The `.reduce` calls in wire.scala:328/434/440 and cost.scala:428 are on StructuralReducer (cost.scala:204), a different type. So this is a LATENT PUBLIC-API HOLE: reachable by any caller outside the module, not currently reached from inside it.

SO THE HONEST GRADE: not "our numbers are wrong today", but "the documented gate is one of two doors and the other is public and open". Which is your own rule - catching it at one consumer leaves the hole open for every other - applied to entry points rather than consumers.

CHEAPEST FIX DIRECTION, not prescribed: move the weight check into WindowReducer.reduce, or make the trait's reduce take a type that cannot carry an invalid weight. A comment pointing at Reduction.reduce is not enough, because the docstring already says that and it is already true and the hole is still open.
